key.name: show-cpu
key.description: Whether to display the CPU percentage in the top panel.

key.name: show-ram
key.description: Whether to display the RAM percentage in the top panel.

key.name: speed-unit
key.description: Unit used for network throughput in the top panel: bytes (KB/s, MB/s) or bits (Kbps, Mbps).

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often network, CPU, and memory counters are sampled.

key.name: show-graph
key.description: Whether to show the 60-sample download/upload graph in the popup menu.

key.name: color-thresholds
key.description: Color CPU and RAM labels amber at 80% or higher and red at 95% or higher.

key.name: ignored-interfaces
key.description: Comma-separated interface names or wildcard patterns (e.g. docker0, veth*) to exclude from totals.
